# BrainDAW Web

BrainDAW requests a mixable audio session on browsers that expose the Audio Session API. The browser and operating system control playback when you leave the tab or lock the phone. Recorded nature beds now loop in the audio graph, and ambience events and pad changes are scheduled ahead to reduce gaps.

Open the [hosted studio](https://rmanmetaverse.github.io/BrainDAW/) or serve the contents of `BrainDAW-Web.zip` over HTTPS or localhost. Install the PWA from a supported browser. After the app finishes caching, the included audio and worklets can load offline.

The release workflow verifies the production build, first-click audio, mobile layout, preset and timeline persistence, and offline playback.
